title: Playboy Magazine November 1973 Ursula Andress James Dickey JFK Centerfold Intact
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. The dark cover shows scuffing and surface scratches, most visible at the upper left and along the bottom, plus toning, edge wear and corner wear. The back cover has soiling and toning along the edges. Spine intact. No mailing label. Centerfold is present (opening page shown in photo 3). Please review the photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, November 1973 issue. Cover price one dollar. Centerfold present - see photo 3.

Features:
- The Return of Ursula Andress - the pictorial that brought the original Bond girl back to Playboy
- Playboy Interview with James Dickey, the poet and author of "Deliverance"
- Garry Wills on John Kennedy, published for the tenth anniversary of the assassination
- Sizing Up Cigars
- Sex in Cinema '73, the annual film roundup

Miss November is Monica Tidwell; the opening page of her Playmate of the Month feature is shown in the third photo.

Cigar cover with Anne Randall, Miss May 1967, in the lavender slip and red velvet chair.

The back cover carries a 1973 Tareyton 100's ad, "Us Tareyton smokers would rather fight than switch!", with the black-eye model and the FTC figures dated Feb '73.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage - see the condition note.
